def transform(grid):
 h,w=len(grid),len(grid[0]); out=[r[:] for r in grid]
 # boundary color 2 segments at top and bottom
 for r,c in [(i,j) for i,row in enumerate(grid) for j,v in enumerate(row) if v==6]:
  # shoot toward top/bottom endpoint segment containing the marker column
  top=grid[0][c]==2
  bottom=grid[-1][c]==2
  if top or bottom:
   dr=1 if top else -1
   i=r+dr
   while 0<=i<h and grid[i][c]!=2:
    if out[i][c]==5: out[i][c]=6
    i+=dr
   out[r][c]=4
 return out
